S1.resumeError: thread 01a15e35-108a-7772-a1b0-e281f95d3e53 already has an active writer

ledger.generation1: superseded by takeover (Deszo ledger, not Codex state)

S3b.error: no rollout found for thread id 01a15e35-108a-7772-a1b0-e281f95d3e53

notes: S1 shows Codex refuses a second writable admission to a session that a live process holds in the same home. The mechanism is a per-thread writer lock in thread-writer-locks/, with OS file locking. Lock files persist as zero-length files after exit, so their presence is not evidence that a lock is held.
S2 shows the stale owner keeps writing: Codex has no owner generation, so a superseded holder is stopped only by Deszo terminating or fencing it.

S3a and S3b are the isolation question. A profile without the experimental capability is refused by a capability gate (not by ownership). A profile that declares it is tested while the owner is alive, because the writer lock belongs to the holder's home, not to the rollout.
The default profile was not started or written. Only file names were listed.
